title: Dependency-Track
description: Dependency-Track 5.2.1 (API server monolith + frontend, PostgreSQL dtrack-db). Curated from the upstream dev dashboards shipped in the DT repository at tag 5.2.1 (overview, database, DEX, notifications); the overview is imported as 'Dependency-Track (official)'. Sources: docs/dashboards/security.md

options.content:
### Dependency-Track: SBOM and vulnerability analysis
**What it does here.** The API server (`dependency-track-api-server`, one pod, topology monolith) stores SBOMs, mirrors
vulnerability databases (NVD, OSV, GitHub Advisories, EPSS, KEV) and analyses components; the frontend is static (no
metrics). Background work runs in two engines: **db-scheduler** (cron tasks: mirrors, metrics, maintenance) and **DEX**
(the durable workflow engine that executes analysis, mirroring and notification workflows). Login via Keycloak (OIDC).

**Healthy looks like:** UP, no 5xx, scheduled tasks `ok`, DEX workers not saturated, circuit breakers closed, DB pool with
no pending threads, heap below max. The API metrics only exist after the first API request since the pod started
(Micrometer creates them lazily), so HTTP panels can be empty right after a restart.

**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 -n dependency-track logs deploy/dependency-track-api-server`; database
→ the CloudNativePG dashboard (Databases folder, cluster `dtrack-db`); failing mirror tasks → outbound internet / NVD API
limits. Docs: [DT docs](https://docs.dependencytrack.org/), [upstream dashboards](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards).

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: API server up
panels.description: Scrape of the management port (:9000/metrics, job dependency-track-api-server-metrics). Source: Prometheus up.

panels.title: Version / uptime
panels.description: Running version (dt_info) and time since the JVM started (process_uptime_seconds). Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (Build Info, Uptime).

panels.title: HTTP 5xx ratio (5m)
panels.description: Share of API responses with a 5xx status over 5 min (http_server_requests_seconds). Empty right after a restart until the first API request. Formula from DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (HTTP Error Ratio).

panels.title: Scheduled task failures (24h)
panels.description: db-scheduler task executions with result=failed in 24 h (dbscheduler_task_completions_total). A failing mirror task means stale vulnerability data. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (Scheduled Task Failure Rate).

panels.title: Circuit breakers not closed
panels.description: resilience4j circuit breakers protecting DEX buffers that are open, half-open or forced open (resilience4j_circuitbreaker_state == 1). An open breaker rejects writes to that buffer (see the 'not permitted calls' panel). Source: resilience4j Micrometer metrics (https://resilience4j.readme.io/docs/micrometer)

panels.title: Background work: scheduler and DEX workflows
Scheduled tasks
panels.description: One row per db-scheduler task: when it last completed (dbscheduler_task_last_run_timestamp_seconds; tasks that have not run since the pod started are hidden), last duration and failures in 24 h. Mirrors run daily (NVD/OSV/GitHub/EPSS/KEV), Portfolio Vulnerability Analysis and notification dispatch every few minutes. Source: db-scheduler Micrometer metrics, as used in DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards).

panels.title: Workflow runs completed (DEX)
panels.description: Workflow runs finished per hour by workflow and status (dt_dex_engine_runs_completed_total): mirror-vuln-data-source, mirror-kev-data-source, update-portfolio-metrics, analysis... status FAILED/CANCELLED needs a look in the logs. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-dex.json (Run completion rate), grouped by workflowName.

panels.title: Worker concurrency utilization
panels.description: Share of each DEX task worker's concurrency slots in use (dt_dex_engine_task_worker_concurrency_utilization, 0-1). Sustained 1.0 = the worker is saturated and work queues (vuln-analysis during big SBOM uploads is expected). Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-dex.json

panels.title: Polls skipped (backpressure)
panels.description: Worker polls skipped because the worker was full (dt_dex_engine_task_worker_poll_skipped_backpressure_total). Occasional skips are fine; a constant rate means the workers cannot keep up. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-dex.json

panels.title: Circuit breaker rejections and notification outbox
panels.description: Calls rejected by an open circuit breaker (resilience4j_circuitbreaker_not_permitted_calls_total) and notification outbox relay cycles by outcome (dt_outbox_relay_cycles_total). Rejections = DEX buffer writes refused. Sources: resilience4j Micrometer metrics (https://resilience4j.readme.io/docs/micrometer); DT 5.2.1 apiserver-notifications.json

panels.title: HTTP requests by status class
panels.description: API request rate by status class (http_server_requests_seconds_count). Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (HTTP Request Rate By Status).

panels.title: HTTP latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Overall API latency quantiles (http_server_requests_seconds histogram). SBOM uploads and portfolio pages are the slow ones. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (HTTP latency panel).

panels.title: HikariCP pool
panels.description: Connections of the default HikariCP pool to dtrack-db: active, idle, pending (threads waiting for a connection) and the pool max. Pending > 0 for long = pool exhausted. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-database.json

panels.title: DB errors
panels.description: Connection acquisition timeouts (hikaricp_connections_timeout_total), failed JDBI queries (jdbi_query_latency_seconds_count, outcome=failure) and failed DataNucleus queries. Any sustained value = database trouble. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-database.json (Connection timeout rate, JDBI failure rate, Query rate).

panels.title: Heap and container memory
panels.description: JVM heap used vs max (jvm_memory_used/max_bytes, area=heap) and the container working set vs its 4Gi limit. Heap near max = GC thrashing; container near limit = OOM kill. Source: DT 5.2.1 apiserver-overview.json (https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/tree/5.2.1/dev/monitoring/grafana/dashboards) (Heap Used vs Max) plus kubernetes-mixin container memory.
